title: Buff Boi Joe's Jumpstart
author: Julián E.
desc: To kickstart a boi in his journey with a few movements.

ss.note: 1 Set is the set for both legs. Go until you can't stand, then drop the weight and keep going with just your body weight until you can't (gun to head) stand
Kinda a wide range of reps here. Feel it out and focus on that deep stretch and think of the movement as more of active meditation/weighted yoga.

Raise feet on a chair or something similar. Go until you can't with good technique then drop to normal pushups. Keep hips high. Gentle chest touch. 3 sec down, hold for 1 sec, fast up 2/3's of the way
Go to eye level then milk the lowering phase of the exercise. Go until you can't even retract your shoulder blades.
